name: How do custom built-ins compare to freestanding furniture in a home office remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do custom built-ins compare to freestanding furniture in a home office remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom built-in cabinetry provides seamless, floor-to-ceiling storage tailored to your exact room dimensions and equipment, while modular furniture offers temporary, movable storage. Built-ins maximize small or awkwardly shaped rooms, hide wiring cleanly, and add lasting architectural value to your property. The tradeoff is that built-in units are permanent, requiring higher upfront material and carpentry investments, and cannot be relocated if you reconfigure the room later. Modular furniture costs less and moves easily, but it often leaves unused gaps and exposed cords throughout the space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom built-ins maximize usable storage and conceal wiring seamlessly for a permanent fit, while freestanding furniture costs less and remains easy to move.
